description:
Let a code checkout select its out-of-repo data root without per-process environment, from any directory, so every shell, agent and linked worktree reaches the same store.

## Background

`JIT_DATA_DIR` is the only way to select an external data root. A `.jit` symlink in the checkout is refused with `failed to construct repository layout`. Environment selection has three costs in a repository that runs agents in many linked worktrees:

- Every shell and agent must export the variable. An unset variable fails with `JIT repository not found`.
- A relative value resolves against the process directory, so a value that works at the root selects another path from a subdirectory.
- Observed with jit 1.0.0: with `JIT_DATA_DIR` set and the process in a subdirectory of the checkout, worktree information reports that subdirectory as the root. Documents, projections and gate checkers then resolve against the wrong directory, with no error.

A worktree-root setting in the data root points from the store to the code. It cannot name many linked worktrees, so a store shared by several checkouts also needs the invoking checkout to supply its own root.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A setting held in a code repository names its external data root, and every linked worktree of that repository resolves the same data root with no environment variable set.
- [hard] REQ-02: `JIT_DATA_DIR` takes precedence over the setting.
- [hard] REQ-03: With a data root selected through the setting, the worktree root is the top level of the invoking checkout, in the primary checkout and in each linked worktree.
- [hard] REQ-04: Gate checkers started from a linked worktree in that layout run in that worktree and record its commit and branch.
- [hard] REQ-05: With an external data root selected, a command run from a subdirectory of a checkout uses the checkout's top level as the worktree root.
- [hard] REQ-06: A setting that names a missing or unusable data root fails with a typed error naming the path and the setting.
- [hard] REQ-07: A repository without the setting and without `JIT_DATA_DIR` behaves as before this change.
- [hard] REQ-08: The storage-format reference documents the setting, its precedence over `JIT_DATA_DIR` and its interaction with the worktree-root setting.

## Notes

- Found while assessing a move of gf2's tracker data out of its repository. gf2 keeps about 17 linked worktrees.
- The setting's location and format are design choices for planning. It has to be visible from all linked worktrees of a repository.
title: Code checkouts select an external data root without environment variables
